# To-do list (`todo-list`)

A shared list (to-do or shopping): add, check off, reorder, and clear the completed items.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTodoList` (types in `dist/web/home/info/todoList.d.ts`): `section.mh-todo-list`: an `__add` form (an `.mh-input` and a submit button), the open items as a reorderable list (`.mh-reorder.__open`, the layout group's reordering: drag a handle, or Space and the arrows), `__empty`, and a `__done` section whose `__toggle` (`aria-expanded`) shows the checked-off items beside "Clear completed". Each `__item` (`.is-done`) has the reorder `__handle` (open items, with `onReorder`), a native checkbox (`.mh-checkbox.__check`) whose label is the text and note, and a `__remove` button. Changes are announced.

```ts
export function createTodoList(options: TodoListOptions): TodoListHandle;

export interface TodoListOptions {
  /** The list's name ("Shopping"), its accessible name. */
  label: string;
  items: readonly TodoItem[];
  /** Shows the add field; called with the trimmed text. */
  onAdd?: (text: string) => void;
  onToggle?: (id: string, done: boolean) => void;
  /** Shows drag handles on the open items; called with the new order of the open items' ids. */
  onReorder?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Shows a remove button on each item. */
  onRemove?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Shows "Clear completed"; called with the ids of the checked-off items. */
  onClearCompleted?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** The completed section starts open (default false). */
  completedOpen?: boolean;
  /** Reorder instructions and announcements. */
  messages?: Partial<ReorderMessages>;
  labels?: Partial<TodoListLabels>;
}

export interface TodoListHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  update(changes: Partial<TodoListOptions>): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface TodoItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  done: boolean;
  /** A second line ("2 packs", "by Friday"). */
  note?: string | null;
}

export interface TodoListLabels {
  /** The add button's name. */
  add: string;
  /** The add field's name and placeholder. */
  newItem: string;
  /** The completed section's toggle. */
  completed: (count: number) => string;
  clearCompleted: string;
  remove: (text: string) => string;
  /** Shown when nothing is on the list. */
  empty: string;
  /** Shown when everything is checked off. */
  allDone: string;
  /** Announced after a change. */
  added: (text: string) => string;
  checked: (text: string) => string;
  unchecked: (text: string) => string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTodoList, type TodoItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let items: TodoItem[] = [
  { id: 'milk', text: 'Oat milk', done: false, note: '2 cartons' },
  { id: 'bread', text: 'Sourdough loaf', done: false },
  { id: 'apples', text: 'Apples', done: false },
  { id: 'eggs', text: 'Eggs', done: true },
];

const set = (next: TodoItem[]): void => {
  items = next;
  list.update({ items });
};

const list = createTodoList({
  label: 'Shopping',
  items,
  onAdd: (text) => set([...items, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), text, done: false }]),
  onToggle: (id, done) => set(items.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, done } : i))),
  // The ids are the open items in their new order.
  onReorder: (ids) => set([...ids.map((id) => items.find((i) => i.id === id)!), ...items.filter((i) => i.done)]),
  onRemove: (id) => set(items.filter((i) => i.id !== id)),
  onClearCompleted: (ids) => set(items.filter((i) => !ids.includes(i.id))),
});

document.body.append(list.el);
```

## React API

`TodoList` (types in `dist/react/home-info.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTodoList`; reordering comes from the layout group's `bindReorderableList`.

```ts
export function TodoList({ label, items, onAdd, onToggle, onReorder, onRemove, onClearCompleted, completedOpen = false, messages, labels, className }: TodoListProps);

export interface TodoListProps extends TodoListOptions {
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TodoList } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { TodoItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function TodoListExample() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<TodoItem[]>([
    { id: 'milk', text: 'Oat milk', done: false, note: '2 cartons' },
    { id: 'bread', text: 'Sourdough loaf', done: false },
    { id: 'apples', text: 'Apples', done: false },
    { id: 'eggs', text: 'Eggs', done: true },
  ]);
  return (
    <TodoList
      label="Shopping"
      items={items}
      onAdd={(text) => setItems((list) => [...list, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), text, done: false }])}
      onToggle={(id, done) => setItems((list) => list.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, done } : i)))}
      // The ids are the open items in their new order.
      onReorder={(ids) =>
        setItems((list) => [...ids.map((id) => list.find((i) => i.id === id)!), ...list.filter((i) => i.done)])
      }
      onRemove={(id) => setItems((list) => list.filter((i) => i.id !== id))}
      onClearCompleted={(ids) => setItems((list) => list.filter((i) => !ids.includes(i.id)))}
    />
  );
}
```
